title: Comprehensive Coptic Lexicon TEI (incl. DDGLC Greek loanwords)
attribution: Burns, Dylan Michael; Feder, Frank; John, Katrin; Kupreyev, Maxim; Akademienvorhaben Strukturen und Transformationen des Wortschatzes der ägyptischen Sprache (BBAW / Thesaurus Linguae Aegyptiae); Database and Dictionary of Greek Loanwords in Coptic (DDGLC), Freie Universität Berlin. notes: Default Coptic + Greek-loanword lexical source (JAK-19 Done). Pin KELLIA dictionary xml/Comprehensive_Coptic_Lexicon-v1.2-2020.xml (CCL v1.2). Refubium DOI 10.17169/refubium-27566. Rights separation: lexicon data CC BY-SA 4.0; KELLIA dictionary UI/software Apache-2.0 — do not conflate. Phase 2 ships only a minimal, manually spot-checked verified loanword subset under data/sources/mappings/verified-loanwords-ccl-ddglc-v1.json (JAK-38); do not bundle the full TEI by default. Do not wait on DIOSKOROS; no scrape. TLA entry ids (C…) and DDGLC greek_lemma::grl_ID values are preserved on verified rows. ShareAlike applies to adapted lexical exports (JAK-16).
editor: Burns / Feder / John / Kupreyev; BBAW TLA; DDGLC FU Berlin
